$comment: Two-speed gearbox on the bench, LDraw frame (-y up). Medium motor A at the origin drives the input axle (6L, vertical through its output, x=0) carrying an 8T at y=-70 and a 16T at y=-130 (10 LDU clear of the motor's top). The output axle (10L) turns in the beam under the housing at x=40 (40 LDU = 8T+24T = 16T+16T pitch radii) and carries, free on round holes, the 24T clutch gear 2471 at y=-70 and the 16T clutch gear 18946 at y=-130; between them a ridged axle joiner 6538b fixed on the axle and the driving ring 6539 on it (neutral: its ends touch both gears' clutch faces). The changeover catch 6641 swings about a 4L axle along z through its pivot hole at (78,-100), its bar at (56,-100) in the ring's groove (16 LDU from the output axis: the groove floor 13 + the bar's 2.3); the axle is held by motor B's output (port B), whose housing stands behind (z>54). Motor B turning the catch moves the ring 8 LDU up or down into one clutch gear.
